Name: Willy's Treasure Chest
Author: Smashley41
Description:
[u][size=6][b]Willy's Treasure Chest[/b][/size][/u]

This mod adds a treasure chest to Willy's Fish Shop in which he sells the treasures he's collected during his activities around Pelican Town. This was originally part of my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41414]Willy Sells His Catch[/url] but became complex enough to warrant its own creation. For the complete experience I recommend running both mods together but either mod works fine on its own.

Willy's Treasure Chest, which functions like a shop, is located on the table in the top-right of the Fish Shop (see Images section). It is only available to access during the shop's normal opening hours when Willy is present.

The Chest is replenished daily and can contain any item that is possible to find in a fishing treasure chest or (optionally) panning spot. Some exceptions apply (it won't contain any items that Willy is otherwise selling in the shop, for example).

Each item has a similar percentage chance of appearing in the Treasure Chest as it does in a regular fishing chest. Please check [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fishing#Treasure_Chests]this page[/url] and [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Pans#Items_Obtained]this page[/url] of the Stardew Valley Wiki for a rundown of which items can be found in fishing treasure chests and panning spots, respectively, as well as their chances of appearing. Further restrictions can apply to an item's appearance, depending on your chosen config options, which are explained further below.



[b][u][size=4]CONFIG OPTIONS
[/size][/u][/b]You can fine-tune Willy's Treasure Chest with the options below. As usual, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is [i]extremely highly recommended[/i].

[b]LOOT POOL MODE:
[/b]Choose how the loot pool for the Treasure Chest is generated. You have two options. Each mode has its advantages and disadvantages, offering a trade-off between early convenience and long-term growth.

[list]
[*][b]Gameplay Oriented:[/b] The Gameplay Oriented Loot Pool follows similar logic to the vanilla game, with potential items restricted by the farmer's fishing levels and other requirements. Things will start slow, with only the potential for basic items to appear, with better items appearing as the player progresses through the game, with notable expansions to the potential loot pool after reaching fishing levels 2, 6, and mastery. This mode is geared towards longer playthroughs and balanced gameplay. The advantage is that every potential item becomes available over time. With this mode there are 98 potential items that can appear in the Chest and you can expect 0-5 items per day (yes, sometimes it will be empty).
[*][b]Lore Friendly:[/b] The Lore Friendly Loot Pool is generated as though Willy has done the fishing, with all player-related restrictions removed, meaning that most items can potentially appear from the start of the game. Some world-related restrictions still apply (i.e. Qi Beans will only appear if the quest is active, Mystery Boxes will not appear until they are unlocked etc.). This loot pool also has slightly higher chances for each item to appear.  [i]However[/i], certain items will never appear in this loot pool (most notably those restricted behind Mastery levels - including Fishing Mastery, which means any item that can only appear in golden fishing chests). This mode is for those who want an early game boost and prefer its lore-friendly nature. With this mode there are 74 potential items that can appear in the Chest and you can expect 0-10 items per day (an empty chest will be much rarer than in the Gameplay Oriented pool).
[/list]
I have put a lot of effort into each of these loot pools, but I personally prefer the Gameplay Oriented version, and as a reward for choosing this loot pool, you can expect a random rotation of shop dialogue messages sourced from fishing proverbs and other sayings. The Lore Friendly loot pool has a single shop dialogue message.

[b]PRICES:
[/b]Choose how much Willy charges for his treasures. You have four options: [b]Bargain[/b] (everything is half price), [b]Standard[/b] (the game's default prices, with some priceless items having their prices set manually by the mod), [b]Markup[/b] (everything is increased by 50%) and [b]Doubled[/b].

[b]INCLUDE PANNING STOCK:
[/b]Whether to expand the loot pool after panning has been unlocked. Applies to both loot pool modes. This will increase the chances of items appearing if they can be found in both fishing treasure chests and panning spots, and will add 10 new items to the Gameplay Oriented loot pool and 9 new items to the Lore Friendly loot pool.

[b]COMPETITION REWARDS:
[/b]Whether to add the rewards from the Trout Derby and SquidFest to the loot pool on the day after each festival concludes. Most of these items are guaranteed to appear if this option is selected. Applies to both loot pools. Additionally, you can choose to delay this until Year 2, for those who wish to conquer each competition themselves before the items become readily available at Willy's.

[b]DISTANCE FROM LAND ITEMS (LORE FRIENDLY LOOT POOL ONLY)
[/b]Whether to add items that can only be found in fishing chests when the line is cast further than 1 tile from land. These items are disabled from the Lore Friendly loot pool by default because Willy only fishes in water 1 tile from land. Choosing this option will add a further 12 items to the Lore Friendly loot pool.

[b]GOLDEN EGG REQUIRES PERFECTION (LORE FRIENDLY LOOT POOL ONLY)
[/b]Choose whether perfection is required for the Golden Egg to appear in the Lore Friendly loot pool. By default this is true but you can disable it if you want the Golden Egg to possibly appear at any time.



[b]INSTALLATION[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] are installed
[*]Unzip the mod file to your Stardew Valley Mods folder
[*]Load your game and edit the available options through GMCM
[/list][b]
TRANSLATIONS[/b]
An i18n file is included. You are welcome to create your own translations under the following conditions...
[list]
[*]You translate the file yourself, without using AI
[*]You upload ONLY the i18n file and NOT the full mod
[*]You list this mod as a requirement
[/list]If you create a translation please let me know, I will add a link to it on this page with credit to its creator.


[b]OTHER NOTES, COMPATIBILITY ETC.[/b]
[list]
[*]The Treasure Chest uses the default treasure chest object sprite (credit to ConcernedApe) so should adapt to any retextures and recolours you are using.
[*]The map patch is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url]﻿ and probably most others but if you find any incompatibilities please let me know.
[*]If you ever see the same item appear in the chest twice, please let me know as that is not intended. On rare occasions (usually after fishing festivals with the Competition Rewards option turned on) you may get a yellow SMAPI message about the Chest having multiple items with the same entry ID. Unless the same item does appear twice, it is safe to ignore this message.
[/list]
